cases.intro: Each application is shared between you and one connected student or agent. Both of you see the same requirements, deadlines, fee records and history.
cases.needConnection: Applications open once a connection request is accepted.
cases.openItems: {count, plural, =0 {No open items} one {# open item} other {# open items}}
cases.notFound: This application doesn't exist or isn't shared with you.
cases.overdueBanner: {count, plural, one {# item is past its due date and still open.} other {# items are past their due date and still open.}}
cases.recordsIntro: Disclosed fees, agreed responsibilities, promises, expected dates and payments as reported by either of you. Records can't be edited or deleted: to correct one, add a new record that corrects it. Maqsad never handles money.
cases.onDateHelp: Optional. For example the payment date or the expected date.
cases.summaryHelp: What was disclosed, agreed, promised or paid, in your own words.
cases.paymentNote: Reported by {name}. This is what a party reported, not proof that money moved. Maqsad never handles money and can't confirm payments.
cases.noRecords: No fee or commitment records yet.

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.intro: Messages with your connected students and agents. Messages can't be edited or deleted.
messaging.needConnection: Messages open once a connection request is accepted.
messaging.notFound: This conversation doesn't exist or isn't open to you.
messaging.refreshNote: This page checks for new messages every 10 seconds while it is open.
messaging.empty: No messages yet. Write the first one below.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Updates from your connections and shared applications. Maqsad doesn't send email or push notifications.

kinds.record_added: {name} added a fee or commitment record to “{title}”

disputes.title: Report a problem
disputes.privacy: Only you and Maqsad's admins can see what you send here. The other person is not shown your report.
disputes.open: Report suspicious behaviour or raise a dispute
disputes.detailsHelp: Describe what happened, with dates. Don't include passwords or bank card numbers.
disputes.sent: Sent. Maqsad's admins will review it. You can follow its status under My reports and disputes.
disputes.empty: You haven't sent any reports or disputes.

reasons.pressure_tactics: Pressure to pay or decide quickly
